subject.title: [Feature]: Expose sessionKey/runId to outbound message hook for deterministic verification

question: What sensitive run/session evidence should OpenClaw expose to pre-send plugin hooks for deterministic outbound verification, and on which hook surface should that contract live?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but exposing transcript/tool evidence is a public Plugin SDK and privacy/security boundary decision that automation should not choose.

options.title: Design bounded hook evidence
options.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields and plugin permission semantics, then implement the additive contract with docs and tests.

options.title: Make reply_payload_sending canonical
options.body: Use the newer reply_payload_sending surface as the supported pre-delivery API and narrow this issue to the missing run/evidence fields there.

options.title: Fold into broader trace or policy work
options.body: Make a broader trace-context or outbound-policy issue canonical while preserving this issue's deterministic verification examples as acceptance criteria.

recommendation.title: Design bounded hook evidence
recommendation.body: Specify minimal redacted run/session/evidence fields and plugin permission semantics, then implement the additive contract with docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the closest routing owner from prior review and landing history for outbound hook/session-key and reply payload hook contracts.
